New York Knicks — injuries
Hart (illness) won't play Tuesday against the Bucks, Kristian Winfield of the New York Daily News reports.
Hart is sick in addition to dealing with a sore right ankle, so he'll skip Tuesday's game, which will be the first of a back-to-back set. Landry Shamet should continue to start in Hart's absence, and Jordan Clarkson will have the chance for some extra minutes.
